name: ag2-meeting-runtime
description: Global plugin wrapper for safe AG2-style meeting runtime triggers.

interface.shortDescription: Run an AG2-style meeting through safe installed CLIs.
interface.longDescription: AG2-style group meetings with proposer, skeptic, synthesizer, and orchestrator-style turn control through installed visible-agent-orchestrator CLIs. The plugin wrapper defaults to mock/no-live; any lower-level live smoke path requires explicit host-local approval.
defaultPrompt: Review this idea with an AG2-style meeting.
Run a mock AG2 meeting for this task.
Run a mock AG2 meeting for an implementation design.
